corrections.why: DR-03 true circles. Quadrant fits give r 31.38 to 32.05 with centres within 1 px of each other; the hands' corner measures (166.4, 42.3). The hour hand is drawn level (it measures 175.6 deg).

corrections.what: Drew the rim's red accent as a filled crescent bounded by the rim's inner edge (r 28.55 about the clock centre) and a second circle, r 20.35, centred 13.7 px from the clock centre toward 1:30; it meets the inner edge at about 12 and 3 o'clock

Two true circles reproduce that taper; the black rim runs underneath.

source_notes: Kept as drawn: the head stands just clear of the shoulder; the near arm is a short stroke from inside the body down into the desk top; the laptop is a three-sided screen standing on the desk; the two legs splay outward (5.1 and 3.8 deg, as measured); the arrow stands clear of both the worker and the clock. Red: the arrow and the rim crescent, from the red sheet.
